name: CookPreset
doc: Encoding quality is an explicit cook input, independent of the execution budget. New imports default to Balanced; projects and individual textures can select HQ.

variants.name: balanced
variants.doc: Balanced compression search, the default for interactive project imports.

variants.name: highQuality
variants.doc: Deeper compression search for higher-quality assets and background recooks.

variants.name: fast
variants.doc: Reduced compression search for the first interactive generation.
